topic.label: Human Language
topic.desc: Human languages as a subject and a working domain: sounds, words, grammar, meaning, vocabulary, translation and localisation, writing systems and Unicode, computational linguistics, and language variation and learning.

concepts.label: Computational Linguistics
concepts.desc: Language processing: tokenisation, tagging, parsing, language identification, corpora and evaluation of language models.

concepts.label: Vocabulary and Lexicography
concepts.desc: Words and their histories: etymology, senses, collocations, dictionaries, glossaries and terminology.

concepts.label: Translation and Localization
concepts.desc: Moving meaning between languages: translation quality, terminology consistency, cultural adaptation and locale formats.

concepts.label: Language Variation and Learning
concepts.desc: Dialects, registers and change over time, how people learn second languages and how endangered languages are documented.

concepts.label: Writing Systems and Text Encoding
concepts.desc: Scripts and their handling in software: alphabets, syllabaries and logographs, Unicode, normalisation and text direction.

skills.label: Corpus and Evaluation Designer
skills.desc: Builds a labelled test set for a language task, picks metrics and reports where scores hide weak languages or dialects.

skills.label: Language Identifier
skills.desc: Identifies the language of a text, reports confidence and warns on short or mixed-language input.

skills.label: Tokenisation Designer
skills.desc: Chooses word, subword or character tokenisation for a language and shows how it splits sample text.

skills.label: Etymology Tracer
skills.desc: Traces a word's history through earlier forms and related languages and separates documented steps from guesses.

skills.label: Terminology Glossary Builder
skills.desc: Collects domain terms with approved translations and definitions and flags terms used inconsistently.

skills.label: Word Sense Disambiguator
skills.desc: Lists the senses of a word with examples and chooses the one that fits a given sentence, with the clue used.

skills.label: Locale and Format Localizer
skills.desc: Adapts dates, numbers, currencies, units and text length for a locale and finds strings that do not fit.

skills.label: Text Translator
skills.desc: Translates a passage, keeps names and terminology consistent and marks sentences where more than one translation is reasonable.

skills.label: Translation Quality Reviewer
skills.desc: Reviews a translation against its source for omissions, mistranslations and tone and scores each issue by severity.

skills.label: Dialect and Variety Profiler
skills.desc: Describes the features that mark a dialect or variety and cautions against stereotyping speakers from a few features.

skills.label: Language Documentation Planner
skills.desc: Plans recordings, transcription and glossing for an under-documented language with consent and community ownership recorded.

skills.label: Language Learning Planner
skills.desc: Plans study for a learner by level and goal, ordering vocabulary, grammar and listening practice with checkpoints.

skills.label: Text Direction Checker
skills.desc: Checks mixed left to right and right to left text for ordering and punctuation problems and suggests markup fixes.

skills.label: Script and Encoding Identifier
skills.desc: Identifies the script and encoding of a text, detects broken encodings and proposes the conversion.

skills.label: Unicode Normalization Advisor
skills.desc: Explains and applies normalisation forms and case folding so equal-looking strings compare equal.

mcp.name: Smartling
mcp.desc: Translate content and manage Smartling projects, jobs, and quality issues directly from your AI assistant.

mcp.name: DeepL
mcp.desc: Translate text and documents across 100+ languages, with your preferred styles applied
